purpose: Prevent an under-retrieved v4 census from being frozen merely because the first legal-open-fulltext route was narrow, without reintroducing v3's label-to-proxy duplication as if it were independent source evidence.

historical_comparator.role: mandatory discovery-coverage benchmark; never formula, operationalization, or selection authority

rules.discovery_coverage_floor: Before dimensions or feature decisions can be frozen, all 432 historical discovery labels must receive a material v4 reconciliation. A historical label may seed discovery but cannot itself become a v4 family without a new English source record and a recorded evidence status.
rules.dimension_coverage_floor: Before dimensions can be frozen, all 66 historical dimension labels must be reconciled through their member labels. A lower number of v4 canonical dimensions is allowed only for a documented H2-approved many-to-one merge showing the same construct, role, information source, and T0 boundary.
rules.coverage_dispositions: All 432 comparator labels must have an auditable final reconciliation: recovered_v4_family, documented_merge, h2_scope_exclusion, or unresolved_source_gap. An unresolved gap blocks final selection and training freeze.
rules.selection_interpretation: This is a coverage-completeness condition, not a numerical quota for canonical families or dimensions. Final selected features and retained formal dimensions follow the published T0, formula, provenance, data, and non-constant gates; they are never padded to a historical count.
rules.prohibited_shortcut: Do not copy v3 labels, formulas, feature membership, pattern-matched proxies, or lexical surrogates into v4 as if they were new source evidence. Do not use model performance to satisfy a floor.

freeze_effect: The current 9-family/1-dimension intermediate branch remains invalidated. No complete_indicator_library.csv, candidate_dimensions.csv, feature_gate_decisions.csv, feature matrix, HGB model, or OOF output may be frozen until this amendment's coverage gate passes.
